description: Dialogue-specific vocabulary for the 105 verified dialogues plus the separate Original Source 85 library. Original Source items are selected from vocabulary terms that occur in their restored segments.

Lists focus on useful interpreting terminology and intentionally exclude filler words and false-context matches such as “of course”.
A term can appear in more than one dialogue because progress is tracked separately for each dialogue.
